# Disclosure

A show/hide section on native / , with a rotating chevron, an optional hint, and its open state remembered per section on this device.

`SongNodes.Disclosure` · Data

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.Disclosure summary="…">…</SongNodes.Disclosure>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.Disclosure" summary="…">…</x-import>
```

## Props (DisclosureProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `summary` * | `string` | Summary text, sentence case. |
| `hint` | `string` | Optional right-aligned hint ("2 on", "1 to 10"). |
| `rememberKey` | `string` | Storage key; open state is remembered per section on this device. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | Initially open when nothing is remembered. |
| `boxed` | `boolean` | Bordered box variant (filter rail). |
| `children` * | `ReactNode` | Section content. |
